nodes.label: Feature-Based Architecture
nodes.rationale: Features under src/features/[name]/ with index.ts as sole public API; no cross-feature internal imports or cycles; shared code in src/shared/.

nodes.label: Quality Gates
nodes.rationale: Commits blocked unless pnpm tauri build, type-check, lint, and test all pass.

nodes.label: Dependency Injection via useServices
nodes.rationale: External APIs behind ServiceContext; tests inject mocks via ServicesProvider; no direct @tauri-apps/* outside adapters.

nodes.label: Test Pyramid Strategy
nodes.rationale: Unit (Vitest) → integration with mock services → component tests of user behavior; colocated __tests__/.

nodes.label: No useTransition for Image Navigation
nodes.rationale: useTransition on image navigation degrades UX; ImageViewer must receive key on folder change.
